text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Riiiiing*...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Sooooo noisy... Quit yellin' like that, I 
said."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-B-B-But... but waaaah! Now all three of 
us can finally... all three of us—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Come on, calm down a bit, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Are you planning to discharge all that 
carrot juice you just toasted with right 
out of your eyes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At lunchtime, looking over at a corner 
that suddenly got noisy, Narita Taishin, 
Biwa Hayahide, and Winning Ticket were 
gathered together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket: an honest and energetic 
crybaby who is obsessed with becoming a 
"Derby Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And running based on calculated "winning 
formulas," Biwa Hayahide boasts an 
overwhelming rate of top-two finishes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of them seem to get along well with 
Narita Taishin, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I can understand why you feel 
delighted. I'm happy too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—After all, the three of us were able to 
make our debuts together like this.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's right, that's right! I... I 
juuuusttt waaaaahhh...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAHH!! Let's keep competing against 
each other, the three of us, foreverrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...It's too loud, so no.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No way!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, Taishin, you're on the Triple 
Crown route, right!? Me too, me too! I'm 
going for it, too!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The one who's gonna be the Derby Umamusume 
is MEEEEEEEEEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh. I understand both of their 
capabilities very well, of course, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I will not yield victory. The 
title of Triple Crown Umamusume shall be 
mine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, say whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so came the afternoon training 
session—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haa, good grief... My ears still hurt... 
Damn that Ticket.
choice_data_list:
They seemed to be getting along great, as 
always.

They seemed to be getting along great, as 
always.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? You were watching? And that's 
seriously your only takeaway after 
watching?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's not like we're best buddies or 
anything. It's just—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...When you first enroll, you usually 
start out running sets around 1000m to get 
used to it, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Like I have time to take it easy! That's 
why I decided to run the 2400m.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And then... for some reason, two other 
people chimed in with the exact same thing 
at once.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So in the end, it turned into a three-way 
showdown...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, her timing on that move was 
flawless...! It's like Biwa Hayahide-san 
calculated every single detail of this 
race...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Deryaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-san is amazing too, you know?! Her 
explosive burst is just insane...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Ugh, these guys...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Like hell I'm gonna loooose!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, there was no way I could 
properly run Classic distances back then, 
and normally I wouldn't have had the 
leeway to battle neck-and-neck, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
“Back then, though... some kind of power 
welled up inside me—”

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Damn it, as expected, running a proper 
2,400m is still too much for me right 
now...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Still... I clocked a better time than 
usual.)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing, amazing, amazing, 
aaaamaaaaaaziiiiing!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Wh-What, all of a sudden--

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin! That's your name, right!? 
I'm Winning Ticket!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Your late charge at the finish! It sent 
chills down my spine! It was the abso-lute 
beeeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're strong!! A true rival!! Just one 
more race, pleeeaaase!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
One more race... huh? Sounds like an 
entertaining conversation you're having.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I would very much like to participate as 
well, if you don't mind?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on... Who do you guys think you 
are...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...And ever since, Ticket's been 
constantly bugging me, and before I knew 
it, Hayahide was always hanging around 
too."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...That's all.
choice_data_list:
So it all started with the first race we 
ever ran against each other.

It all started with the first race we ever 
ran against each other, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Though some of them weren't 
first-timers.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"It's nothing. ...Anyway, it's not like 
we're best buddies or anything."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But—I know their strength all too well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Both Ticket and Hayahide... I hate to 
admit it, but they're strong.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Those two are aiming for the same Triple 
Crown path. You know what that means, 
right?
choice_data_list: I can't afford to lose now...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If you get it, hurry up and let's go 
train.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket and Biwa Hayahide... In 
preparation for the day she faces them 
both, she continued training hard today.
